description: Simulated binary outcome diabetes (neg, pos) with eight numeric covariates on different scales, some skewed and some zero-inflated: a logistic regression on glucose and mass whose coefficients change at age = 35 and, for age > 35, at pedigree = 0.5. pregnant, pressure, triceps and insulin are noise.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 768L
    age <- 21 + round(stats::rgamma(n, shape = 1.4, scale = 9))
    pregnant <- as.numeric(stats::rnbinom(n, size = 1.5, mu = 3.8))
    glucose <- round(pmax(45, stats::rnorm(n, 121, 31)))
    pressure <- round(pmax(30, stats::rnorm(n, 72, 12)))
    pressure[runif(n) < 0.045] <- 0
    triceps <- round(pmax(7, stats::rnorm(n, 29, 10)))
    triceps[runif(n) < 0.3] <- 0
    insulin <- round(stats::rlnorm(n, log(120), 0.6))
    insulin[runif(n) < 0.49] <- 0
    mass <- round(pmax(18, stats::rnorm(n, 32.5, 7)), 1)
    pedigree <- round(stats::rlnorm(n, log(0.38), 0.6), 3)
    left <- age <= 35
    low <- pedigree <= 0.5
    b0 <- ifelse(left, -1.4, ifelse(low, -0.2, 0.9))
    b1 <- ifelse(left, 1.6, ifelse(low, 0.6, 1.1))
    b2 <- ifelse(left, 0.3, ifelse(low, 1, -0.2))
    eta <- b0 + b1 * (glucose - 120)/30 + b2 * (mass - 32)/7
    diabetes <- factor(ifelse(runif(n) < stats::plogis(eta), "pos", "neg"), levels = c("neg", "pos"))
    data.frame(pregnant = pregnant, glucose = glucose, pressure = pressure, triceps = triceps, insulin = insulin, 
        mass = mass, pedigree = pedigree, age = age, diabetes = diabetes)
}
